part.text:
Fixed. In `src/db.c:127` (lookupKey), the no-touch exemption now checks the command that is actually executing (`server.executing_client->cmd`), which during a script is the inner command (`TOUCH`), instead of the top-level command (`EVAL`) on `server.current_client`. 

- `unit/introspection-2` (includes the failing no-touch TOUCH tests): all pass
- `unit/scripting`, `unit/keyspace`, `unit/type/string`: all pass
